description: HPO terms for the 20 tangier checklist items (configs/checklists/tangier.json), chosen on 2026-10-20 by a Claude helper from the pinned HPO release by name and synonym search and hierarchy checks (pipeline/extract/hpo_lookup.py), D-40. 'observed' is the term a phenopacket may assert when the item is observed; null where the item is a composite, or has no HPO term of the same scope, so the specific feature rows carry it instead. 'excluded' lists every term a phenopacket may mark excluded when the item is explicitly absent. Flagged for review by Jimmy or the panel; not a pre-registered choice.

low HDL cholesterol.note: Decreased circulating HDL-C concentration (exact synonyms 'Low HDL-cholesterol', 'Hypoalphalipoproteinemia').

low apolipoprotein A-I.note: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein A-I concentration (exact synonym 'Reduced apolipoprotein A-I level').

orange-colored or enlarged tonsils.note: Orange discolored tonsils; Enlarged tonsils. Their common parent, Abnormality of the tonsils, is broader (it includes absent tonsils and recurrent tonsillitis), so observed is null and both components are excluded.

recurrent tonsillitis or tonsillectomy.note: Recurrent tonsillitis. HPO has no tonsillectomy term and a tonsillectomy alone does not imply recurrent tonsillitis, so observed is null; only the tonsillitis component can be excluded.

reticulocytosis.note: Reticulocytosis (exact synonym 'Increased reticulocyte count'); renders the review's 'reticulocyte hyperplasia'.

lymphadenopathy.note: Lymphadenopathy. Lipid-laden lymph node macrophages (HP:0034583) is a histological finding, not a descendant, and is left to the free-text rows.

corneal opacity.note: Corneal opacity (exact synonym 'Corneal clouding'); stromal and peripheral opacification are descendants.

skin lipid deposits.note: Dermal foam cells. HPO has no general skin lipid deposit term; Dermal foam cells is narrower (histological), so observed is null. Xanthomatosis is not excluded because it includes tendon xanthomas and the checklist leaves xanthomas out.

intestinal mucosal lipid deposits.note: Accumulation of lipid droplets in small-bowel enterocytes. It is narrower than the item (small-bowel enterocytes only, while the item covers any intestinal mucosa), so observed is null.

peripheral neuropathy.note: Peripheral neuropathy; sensory, motor, sensorimotor and mononeuropathy patterns are descendants.

reduced tendon reflexes.note: Diminished deep tendon reflex (exact synonym 'Reduced tendon reflexes'); Hyporeflexia and Areflexia are its children.

reduced deep sensation.note: Impaired proprioception, whose children include Impaired vibratory sensation, matching deep (proprioceptive and vibration) sensation. HPO has no 'deep sensation' term; review whether the scope is the same.

coronary artery disease.note: Coronary artery atherosclerosis (exact synonym 'Coronary disease'); Premature coronary artery atherosclerosis is a descendant.

non-coronary atherosclerotic arterial di.note: Cerebral artery, aortic, renal artery and pulmonary arterial atherosclerosis. Atherosclerosis itself includes coronary disease, so observed is null; Peripheral arterial stenosis is not excluded because stenosis need not be atherosclerotic, and HPO has no brachiocephalic or iliac atherosclerosis term.

glucose intolerance or impaired insulin.note: Glucose intolerance; Impaired first-phase insulin secretion (the only insulin-secretion term). Composite with no common term below Abnormal glucose homeostasis, so observed is null.

low LDL cholesterol.note: Decreased circulating LDL-C concentration (exact synonym 'Reduced low-density lipoprotein cholesterol level').
